lines.text: Jehoshaphat succeeded Asa and strengthened himself against Israel by stationing troops in every fortified city of Judah.
The LORD was with Jehoshaphat because he walked in the earlier ways of David and did not seek the Baals.
Jehoshaphat's heart delighted in the LORD's ways, and he removed the high places and the golden calves from Judah.
In the third year, Jehoshaphat sent officials, Levites and priests to teach Judah, carrying the ark.
The dread of the LORD fell on the surrounding kingdoms, and the Arabs brought Jehoshaphat rams and goats.
